tei:div.tei:p: dus 'khor rdzogs rim gyi sngon 'gro dad pa'i rol mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i lam gyi mthar thug zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi 'khrid kyi sngon 'gro dad pa'i rol mtsho zhes bya ba/ dpal ldan bla ma dang po'i sangs rgyas la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas bzhi yi bde stong ni/ /bzhi pa'i lam mchog rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyis| |legs par sbyangs las 'bras bu'i sangs rgyas mchog khyab bdag dus kyi 'khor lo rgyal gyur cig /theg pa'i mthar thug rdo rje theg pa'i rtse/ /dbang gi mthar thug bzhi pa'i lam gyi mchog /rnal 'byor mthar thug rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di| |ston mdzad yongs 'dzin mthar thug la phyag 'tshal/ /rang nyid lam 'dir goms pa'i 'bras bu ni/ /skal ldan bzhan la spel bar bya phyir dang*| |rgya bod mkhas grub mang pos bshad pa la'ang*/ /ha cang spros dang mi gsal 'khrul pa'i skyon/ /mthong nas tshul 'dir cung zad 'bad pa la/ /'das dang ma 'das rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis/ /bzod cing dgyes pa'i thugs kyis skyong ba dang*/ /sde drug bsrung mas mthun rkyen grub par mdzod/ /'dir rgyal ba thams cad kyi gsung gi gsang ba'i yang gsang ba rgyud kyi rgyal po gzhan thams cad du legs par sbas pa/ skal ba shin tu chen po'i yang chen por gyur pa'i snod ldan byang shaṃ bha la'i yul gyi sems can theg pa mchog la zhugs pa rnams kyi ched du gsal bar bstan pa dbang bzhi pa'i lam gyi mthar thug 'phags pa'i yul gyi shing rta chen po dag gis kyang ma myangs pa'i bdud rtsi chen po zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dpal sbyor ba yan lag drug pa zhes bya ba bla ma dam pa'i drin las nyams su len par byed pa la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro dpyid las ltar gsag sbyang bya ba/ dngos gzhi dbyar las ltar nyams su blang ba/ blang rjes ston las ltar 'bras bu ngo sprod do/ /dang po la rgyud snod rung du byed pa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/

sdig sgrib 'dag par byed pa yig brgya'i sgom bzlas/ byin brlabs 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ tshogs rdzogs par byed pa maṇ+ḍal gyi sgrub pa/ ye shes 'char bar byed pa lhan skyes kyi rnal 'byor ro/ / dang po ni/ spyir ring ba'i sngon 'gro lam thun mong ba rnams kyis rgyud sbyong ba dang*/ khyad par rgyud sde 'og ma rnams kyi rnal 'byor ci rigs pa sngon du gtong ba dang*/ yang dgos dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas dbang bdun rdzogs par blangs te bskyed rim rgyas pa bsnyen sgrub bzhi ka rdzogs pa la myong ba sna zin thon pa yan chod dang*/ nyan pa po'i dbang bzhi thob nas dam tshig dang sdom pa dag pa la sogs pa dgos la/ ma mtha'ang lha dang chos dang bla ma la mos gus drag pos dbang thob cing dam tshig la gnas par bya ste/ 'dir thun mong min pa'i skyabs 'gro ni/ sangs rgyas slob dpon dbang mchog thob| |des bstan thabs shes dbyer med chos/ /der gnas dge 'dun rnam gnyis la/ /rab tu dwangs bas skyabs su 'chi/ /zhes pa ltar rang la dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur ba'i slob dpon du sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ des bstan pa'i bskyed rdzogs su chos thams cad dang*/ de nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo ru dge 'dun thams cad 'dus pas skyabs gsum gzhan du mi 'tshol ba'i bsam sbyor khyad par can 'bral med du skyong ba'i ngang nas dang*/ khyad par rang la dngos su snang ba'i bla ma nyid kyi/ sku dge 'dun/ gsung dam chos/ thugs sangs rgyas nyid du lhag par mos pas kyang dkon mchog gzhan nas btsal mi dgos par skyabs gsum bla ma nyid du snang bar mos pa dang*/ 'on kyang lhan skyes la gzhan dang gzhan du snang ba thams cad kyang bla ma nyid kyi sku gsung thugs kyi bskod pa mi 'dra tsam gyi ye shes kyi cha shas su shes nas skyabs ston pa po dang skyabs dngos dang de grub pa'i grogs thams cad bla ma la zhu ba ni 'dir skyabs 'gro yin gyi/

de ltar ma shes pa'i dkon mchog gsum gyi gral shoms rgyas par sgom pa sogs ni bla med tsam gyi skyabs 'gro yang ma yin no/ 'on kyang blo lhan skyes la tha dad du snang ba dang stun na'ang mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma gtso bor gzhugs pa'i ye shes kyi cha las/ nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi thams cad sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun gyi sku'i bkod pa gang la gang 'dul gyis khyab cing gang bar bzhugs pa la skyabs yul zhus/ zhu ba po rang dang sems can thams cad rang bzhin rnam dag bde gshegs snying po ngo bo gcig kyang rnam rtog gis rgyud tha dad du snang ba nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam thams cad| rang bzhin srid zhir lhung bas nyams thag pa'i skyabs mgon zhu bar blo rtse gcig pa'i mos gus drag po dang*/ tshul khams gsum rgya theg gi nga ro drag pos| bla ma kun 'dus bla ma rin po che la skyabs su 'chi'o/ de bzhin du sangs rgyas| dam chos/ dge 'dun/ yi dam/ chos skyong*/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma rin po che la skyabs su 'chi'o/ /zhes stan thog gcig tu yang tshar stong dang*| de tsam ma nus na'ang lnga brgya/ sum brgya/ brgya la sogs pa lus kyi ba spu ldang ba dang*/ rngul bud pa dang*/ mig nas mchi ma 'brub pa ma byung gi bar du yang bskyar bya'o/ /gnyis pa yig brgya ni/ dam tshig gsum bkod du gsungs shing bslab btus su drangs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa'ang skabs gzhan du grub na byin rlabs che mod kyi/ 'dir rgyud sde gong ma gnyis su gsungs pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa ni/ mngon rtogs kyi mgor bkod pa bzhin bsgom bzlas legs par bya zhing*/ de mi shes pas snying po brgyan nas 'byung ba'i spyi 'gro bzhin yang rung ste da lta gsang 'dus 'phags lugs pa rnams byed pa 'di bu ston rin po ches sbyor drug gi sngon 'gror bkod pa ji bzhin yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang grub na rang rang gi rgyud nas 'byung ba'i rdor sems kyi sku mdog phyag mtshan dgos so/

/de yang stan thog rer stong phrag re tsam/ yid 'jur mig drangs pa byas te/ yun ring du 'bad pas dngos su lus yang ba dang skad bde ba dang sems gsal du song ba sogs dang*/ rmi lam du phyi nang gi khrus byas pa dang*/ gos dkar po gyon pa dang*/ me tog dkar po thu ba la sogs pa sdig pa dag pa'i ltas gsal po byung byung gi bar du 'bad dgos te/ dge las gang byed kyang rang rang gi las kyi sgrib pas bar du gcod pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ sku'i bkod pa sgom pa tsam la mi zer gyi| mos gus khyad par can bskyed pa yin te/ dad pa sngon 'gro ma ltar bskyed pa ste/ zhes dang*/ dad pa sangs rgyas dad pa chos/ /dad pa dge 'dun dad pa pha| |dad pa ma ste dad pa grogs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dad pas sna ma drangs na sbyin sogs gang yang dge ba tsam du yang mi 'gro/ dad pa yang las 'bras la yid ches pa dang*/ bden bzhi'i blang dor la byed 'dod pa'i dad pa sogs ni thos bsam mang pa'i shes rab kyis skyed dgos pas las dang po la skyed dka' bas thog mar dkon mchog gi yon tan la dang ba'i dad pa skye thabs la 'bad dgos shing*/ de yang bla ma la dang ba'i dad pa nyid thog mar 'bad pas btsal bar bya ba yin gyi/ 'di ma skyes na sangs rgyas la dang ba'i dad pa la yang sangs rgyas mi dgyes shing*/ bla mar mos gus yod na sangs rgyas kyi ming mi shes kyang de la rgyal ba dgyes pa'i phyir ro/ /des na grub thob gong ma dag gis bla ma'i mos gus gcig pos chog pa yi/ zhes gsungs pa ni lam gyi rtsa ba ngos zin pa'i gtam yin no/ /de ltar de skyed pa la lung rigs man ngag gsum las/ lung ni/ 'dul ba lung 'phran tshegs las/ kun dga' bos tshangs spyod kyi phyed dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rag las par go nas ston pa la de skad zhus pas/ ston pas de skad ma zer shig phyed du ma zad ril po yongs su rdzogs par de la rag lus so zhes rgyas par gsungs shing*/

bsrung thabs lnga'i nang nas kyang gnas bla ma la bsten pa gtso bor gsungs nas de'i mtshan nyid dang bsten tshul shin tu rgyas par gsungs pa dang*/ mdo sde las ni shin tu rgyas la/ khyad par sangs rgyas phal po che'i sdong po bkod pa'i mdo las byang chub sems dpa' gzhon nu nor bzang dang*/ khye'u dpal 'byung dang bu mo dpal gyi blo gros kyi rnam thar rnams dang sher phyin 'bring bsdus kyi rtag tu ngu'i le'ur shin tu gsal bar gsungs te/ lung tshig yi ge mang pas 'jigs nas ma bris pas de dang de dag tu lta bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du rgyud sde rnams las kyang shin tu rgyas par gsungs te/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid ces sogs dang*/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan gcig skyes/ /gang du yang ni mi rnyed de/ /bla ma'i dus thabs bsten pa dang*/ /bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya/ /zhes sogs dang*| rim lngar rgya che rol pa'i lung drangs pa las/ thams cad stong pa rmad chen po| |dwangs zhing gsal ba'i ye shes che/ /bla ma nyid kyi drin gyis ni/ /de nas de ni gsal mthong 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs nas| |bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsam/ /de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen pa'i// ye shes mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /bla med byed pa slob dpon gyi/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mchod byas pas/ /de yis bsod nams ma byas cing*/ /dka' thub ma bsten ci zhig yod/ /zhes sogs dang*/ bla ma'i drin gyis phan pa'i lung thob na/ /grol bar mi gyur snyam yang grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes sogs dang*/ khyad par rgyud 'dir/ gang zhig mi yi 'jig rten du ni dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa sdig bral de bdag ste/ /de mnyes pa yis bdag ni mgu ste de la khro ba'i me yis khros pa nyes pa chen po'o/ /de la gnod pa byas pas sems can rnams ni nges par dmyal bar 'gro ste 'di la ngo mtshar med/ /'di nyid sems can rnams la thar pa bde mnyam ster byed bu rnams dag gis phyag 'os mchod 'os so//

zhes gsungs so/ /de bzhin du rdo rje gur las kyang*/ nga nyid slob dpon gzugs gnas pas/ /slob ma rnams las mchod pa len/ /zhes sogs dang*/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /zhes sogs dang*/ de dang gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud du/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad slob dpon gyi ba spu'i khung bu gcig na gnas pas rdo rje 'chang dang 'dra bar blta bar yang dang yang du gsungs pa sogs te lung rgyas pa ni yi ge mang su dwogs pas ma bris so// rigs pa ni/ slob dpon 'phags pa lhas/ ji ltar pha la bu sdug pa/ /de ltar de la skye ma yin/ /'jig rten 'di ni 'og tu blta/ /des na mtho ris kyang rnyed dka'| |zhes gsungs pa ltar rang gi bla ma'i gzugs brnyan byung ma thag tu bla ma la rgyab bstan na mtho ris su skye ba tsam yang dka' ba'i phyir dang*/ slob dpon seng bzang gis/ bcom ldan 'das ma la dang ba ni legs pa thams cad 'thob pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i 'don spo dgos pa sogs/ dad pa dkar chos kyi rtsa ba yin tshul gong du bshad pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir dang*/ khyad par chos rje sa paṇa gyis/ nyi ma'i 'od zer rab tsha yang*/ /me shel med par me mi 'byung/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas byin rlabs kyang*/ /bla ma med par 'byung mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bla ma'i sbrel byed med na sangs rgyas dang 'brel thabs med pa la sogs pa'i rigs pa sgo du ma nas bsams la tshad mas drangs pa'i nges pa rnyed par bya'o/ /man ngag ni/ lus kyis khrus dang gtsang sbra yang bya zhing sems kyi ma dad ma gus pa'i rnyog pa bsal/ gnas khang byi dor yang bya mchod pa ci 'byor yang bsham/ stan bde ba la 'dug la/ gnas khang dang mchod pa lha'i gzhal med khang dang mchod rdzas su mos nas/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su seng ge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba dang nyi ma dang dar dang za 'og la sogs pa gdan gyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can dang g.yas g.yon du rgyal mtshan dang ba dan/

bla re yol ba/ mtha' mchod sprin tshad med pas bskor ba'i dbus su/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid ngo bo bla ma yin pa la rnam pa rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag dang po'i sangs rgyas zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa'am/ lhan skyes/ spyi 'gro'i rdo rje 'chang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yum bcas sam/ rang gang mos kyi yi dam gyi rnam pa'ang rung*/ yang na ngo bo sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid yin pa la rnam pa da ltar snang ba'i tha mal gyi sku'i bkod pa gang yod du bsams kyang rung ste lan mang du yang yun ring du gsal gdab/ sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan rang gis gang mthong yang dang yang du bsam/ khyad par rang la phan 'dogs pa'i zhing du sangs rgyas las kyang lhag pa'i tshul la sogs pa bsams nas mos gus bskyed/ yang dai'i gnas gsum lte ba rnams su sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bo oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥrnams bkod pa'i hūm̐ las 'od zer mtha' med spros te phyogs bcu mtha' med na bzhugs tshad kyi bla ma/ skyabs gsum/ yi dam/ chos skyong rnams rim gyis spyan drangs te gnas bzhir rim gyis stim/ skyabs gnas mtha' dag 'dus par thag bcad de/ de la phyag mchod bsnyen bkur sna gcig byas pas skyabs gnas mtha' dag la byas/ gnod pa sna gcig skyal na'ang de bzhin du 'gro ba'i phan gnod kyi zhing zla med par yang yang bsams te/ snying khong rus pa'i dkyil nas mos gus ma skyes kyi bar du sgom zhing phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dang spyir bstod dgos bstod gsol 'debs gang shes bya zhing/ thun mtshams su yang bla ma'i phyogs su lus kyis rngul thon pa dang yan lag gas pa sogs kyi las bya ngag gis snod rung mthong na yon tan gang shes brjod/ skye bo med par phyin nas skad 'dzer 'dzer gyi bar du bstod pa 'don/ bka' bsgo ba byung na/ rang nyid da lta nyid du sangs rgya ba las kyang de sgrub pa 'dam par bya ste|

chos rje sa paṇa gyis/ mgon po gang la mnyes gyur na/ /gal tai bla na med pa yi/ /byang chub thob kyang de dor te/ /skye zhing skye ba thams cad du/ khyod kyi 'phrin las sgrub pa bgyi/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /bzhi pa maṇ+ḍal ni/ rgyud du/ mi shes gang zhig bla ma'i zhabs pad bzang po dag la dus gsum du ni phyag mi byed/ /sdig can gang yin gang zhig rnam mang me tog rnams kyis dus gsum du ni maṇ+ḍal mi byed pa'o/ /zhes dang*/ rgyud gzhan du'ang*/ mchog tu gus pas bla ma la/ /maṇ+ḍal me tog bcas thal mos// ston pa bla ma bsnyen bkur zhing*/ /zhabs la spyi bos phyag bya'o/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas/ dgyes shing gzhan gyis mi 'thab na nyin re lan gsum gsum dngos su zhabs drung du phyin nas zhabs nyid la btugs pa'i phyag bya/ maṇ+ḍal yang dngos su 'bul/ lag stong du mi mjal/ de ltar mchod pa mtha' dag 'dus pa ni maṇ+ḍal yin pa dang de la phyin drug tshang ba sogs kyi bsngags pa mdzad nas rgya gar ba mang pos maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga mdzad cing*/ rje btsun sa skya pa rnams kyang 'di la nan tan mdzad pa ltar/ sa gzhi gtar zhing spos kyis byugs pa'am| rgyu sa dang rdo shing dang rin po che las byas pa la sogs pa gang 'byor dri'i chus phye ma med par byugs/ rin po che'am/ 'bru sna gang 'byor gyi tshom bu dgu pa legs par bkod/ yig drug gis bsangs*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ dbang chen rin po che gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badz+ra su re khe āḥhūṃ/ phyi lcags ri 'khor yug rdo rje'i me ris bskor ba'i dbus su hūm̐ ngam̐ ham̐ gang rung las| ri'i rgyal po ri rab dbus nor bu mar gad/ shar iṇ+ḍa nī la/ lho pad ma rā ga byang karke ta na/ nub rin po che gser las grub pa/ shar du yaṃ lus 'phags po/ lhor raṃ 'dzam bu gling*/ byang du waṃ sgra mi snyan/ nub du laṃ ba longs spyod| de'i nang rim la shar du a sgra gcan/

lho ru āḥnyi ma/ byang du i zla ba/ nub du ā dus me/ rdzogs rim dngos gzhi'i dus dang*/ rdzogs rim la don gnyer gtso bor byed pa'i tshe nang rim bsdud rim du brjod/ dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang pa med pa/ bdag gzhan lus longs spyod dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po dang bcas pa 'di thams cad dpal ldan bla ma dam pa skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi bdag nyid la gus pas dbul bar dgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas phyi nang gi rtogs pa khyad par can myur du rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab du gsol/ zhes sam/ phyi nang gzhan gsum sbyar ba'i maṇ+ḍal rgyas pa'ang nus na dbul te/ thun re la brgya rtsa'am nyi shu rtsa re sogs lag pa la ser kha byung byung gi bar du phul nas/ tshogs rdzogs pa'i rtags/ rmi lam du gter brnyed pa'am/ 'byor ldan gyis 'bul ba byas pa'am/ dngos su rgyal po sogs ky-is bsnyen bkur byas pa sogs byung byung gi bar du nges par bsgrub bo/ /de ltar yang grub thob gong mas tshogs bsags pa'i mi la sgom rang babs su skye zhes gsungs pas thun skal ma chad tsam gyis mi chog go / lnga pa lhan skyes ni/ spyir lha yongs rdzogs kyi mngon rtogs la 'bad pa sngon du song nas/ thun mtshams dang rdzogs rim gyi tshe/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i snang zhen gyi ngang nas bya la/ de yang mngon byang lnga bskyed pa la sogs pa'i bskyed chog rgyas pa mi dgos kyi/ rang nyid skad cig gis dus kyi 'khor lo sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa sna tshogs yum ser mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ bdud 'dod lha dang nyon mongs pa dbang phyug gi snying khar yab g.yas brkyang yum g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis gnan pa/ yab rdo rje rgyan dang yum rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/

yab la mi bskyod pa dang yum la rdor sems kyis dbu brgyan par gyur pa'i gnyis kar gyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ lte bar hoḥ yab kyi gtsug tor du haṃ/ gsang bar k+ṣaḥ yum gyi gsang bar swā/ gtsug tor du hā/ gnyis ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzāḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ rigs bdag rang chas kyis dbang bskur/ oṃ shrīḥkā la tsakra argaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ prok+ṣa naṃ/ añtsa mā ṇaṃ/ āḥhūm̐// oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe/ ma le/ dhū pe/ pra dī pe/ nai we d+ye/ ak+ṣa te/ la s+ye/ hā s+ya/ wa d+ya/ nī t+ya| gī t+ya/ k+ṣa me/ añtsa naṃ/ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can| |srid gsum skye dang 'jig pa med/ /shes dang shes bya gcig pa'i sku// dpal ldan dus 'khor la phyag 'tshal/ skye ba dang ni 'jigs pa med/ /sangs rgyas thams cad skye mdzad ma/ /kun tu bzang mo'i spyod pa can/ /sna tshogs yum de la phyag 'tshal/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥha k+ṣa ma la wa ra yaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ hṛṃ hruṃ hṝṃ hrāḥswāhā/ oṃ phre bi shwa mā ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces thun re la stong phrag re tsam bzla zhing mthar yang mchod bstod byas la*/ snod bcud rten dang brten par gyur pa thams cad yum la thim/ yum yab la thim/ de thugs kha'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu ha/ ha mgo bo/ mgo bo zla tshes/ de thig le/ de nā da/ de yang je phra je phra'i ngang nas mi dmigs pa dang slar yang sngar bzhin du ldang ba dang*/ de bzhin du bsdud pa goms par byas pas rdzogs rim gyi ye shes khyad par can skye ba'i snod rung dang*/ smin byed mchog tu 'gyur zhing*/ sgo gsum la byin brlabs khyad par can 'jug par 'gyur ro//

//rdzogs rim sngon 'gro dad pa'i rol mtsho 'di/ /stag tshang pradzñā rat+na'i nyams len yin/ /rjes 'jug thar 'dod rnams kyang 'di bzhin mdzod/ /phun tshogs thams cad bde blag 'byung bar 'gyur/ /'dis skyes dge ba dri med gaṅga'i chu/ /dge gzhan chu klung mtha' dag bsdus nas ni/ /kun mkhyen rgya mtsho che der legs zhugs nas/ /sems can kun gyi nyer 'tsho cher gyur cig/ ces stag tshang gi lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar ba dge legs 'phel/ /yi ge pa ni bud+dha shwa ra'o/ /maṅga laṃ// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi bka' 'bum/dus 'khor rdzogs rim gyi sngon 'gro dad pa'i rol mtsho/ -PAGE 300--PAGE 299-- PAGE 297-
